reason: E1 shows that hatch spacing and remelting control dislocation density and microstructure in SS316L, but none of the cited evidence directly tests or supports the specific combination of increased scan speed, reduced hatch spacing, and multi-pass remelting for high-entropy alloys, nor does it demonstrate improved dimensional precision or mechanical integrity from this intervention.
premises: Increasing scan speed reduces heat accumulation and thermal gradients
Reducing hatch spacing with remelting promotes uniform thermal profile and microstructure
Controlled remelting reduces porosity and non-uniform grain structures
Homogeneous microstructure with decreased defect density improves dimensional precision and mechanical integrity
